# Synthetic audit fixture: AWS session token in the uppercase
# environment-variable form, as CI secret setup and .env files spell it. The
# label detector matches a lowercased copy of the line, so every case and
# separator variant of the label (session_token, SessionToken,
# 'Session Token', AWS_SESSION_TOKEN) is detected. The value anchor requires
# 16-plus base64-ish value characters after the separator, so short
# synthetic literals such as 'Session Token: EXAMPLE' in the Windows-tier
# tests and prose mentions cannot false-positive. Synthetic value.
AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=SYNTHETICSESSIONTOKEN0123456789
# Dotted-key and Makefile :=: assignment spellings the label grammar
# accepts (found by the selftest spelling matrix). Synthetic value.
session.token = SYNTHETICSESSIONTOKEN0123456789
aws_session_token := SYNTHETICSESSIONTOKEN0123456789
